title: How Cresta turned CX expertise into an agent builder on the Claude Agent SDK
summary: Cresta's Conductor is a meta-agent built on the Claude Agent SDK that transforms business context into production-ready CX agents, cutting deployment time by roughly half. It captures reusable patterns and business rules for consistency while using built-in evals to balance deterministic and flexible workflows. This tool evolved from an internal forward-deployed practice into a customer-facing product.

title: Giving companies more control over their AI agents, with NVIDIA
summary: Claude Managed Agents now integrate with NVIDIA OpenShell for layered security: credentials stored in a separate vault, policies enforced outside the model, sandboxing, and audit trails blocking unauthorized actions. Protection doesn't depend on any single layer and integrates with existing access controls. Managed Agents launch today, with OpenShell open sourced under Apache 2.0.

title: Customize Claude Code with mods
summary: Mods are stackable TypeScript functions that customize Claude Code's behavior, UI, and features via prompts, elements, or capabilities. They run unsandboxed with full machine access and are shared via plugins, so admins should control loading to enforce security. Users should install only from trusted sources due to the elevated permissions required.

title: How CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot scale with Snowflake and Vercel on Claude Marketplace
summary: Claude Marketplace lets companies with Anthropic commitments use pre-approved budgets to provision third-party tools like Snowflake and Vercel under one agreement. CodeRabbit upgraded Vercel in a week; Power Digital scaled from 12 engineers to 800+ users; ThoughtSpot integrated Snowflake's inference API. The marketplace removes procurement friction for managing multi-tool stacks in limited preview.

title: Claude for Government is now generally available
summary: Claude for Government is now generally available to federal and state agencies in a FedRAMP High environment with usage-only pricing and no seat fees. It includes admin controls for audit logs, ATO documentation, and SSO, with Claude Code CLI and Claude for Microsoft 365 in early access through the same environment.

title: Coding sessions are longer and use more context. Claude Opus 5.5 is built with that in mind.
summary: Claude Opus 5.5 is a new model for extended coding sessions, offering 40% lower costs than Opus 5 with 60% cheaper cached token reads and over 50% fewer cache misses. It enables 3.3x longer interactions with 68% fewer interruptions, directly reducing expenses for long-running agent workflows.
